summary: S1 (eps 1-23 canon + ep 24 side story) adapts LN vols 1-4 = manga chapters 1-39 linearly, then SKIPS chs 40-42 (v9, Eurazania/Gazel invitation) and 44-45 (v10, Blumund) — those are deferred to S2 eps 25-28, matching the batch-14 S2 anchors already stored (ep 25 starts at ch 40). Eps 20-23 jump to ch 43 (partial, journey to Ingrassia) then 46-52 (Yuuki/Shizu's students/Dwelling of the Spirits), and the ep 23 finale tacks on a ch 54 tease (LN v4 epilogue, Western Holy Church) that S2 re-adapts properly. Primary source is tensura.fandom per-episode 'Adaptation' sections (fetched via MediaWiki API), corroborated by Wikipedia S1 episode summaries, chapter/episode title equality (ep8=ch10, ep14~ch25, ep15=ch26, ep19=ch37, ep20=ch46), the MAL series-guide stack (S1 = manga 1-54, arc breaks at eps 9/15/20), and wheredoestheanimeleaveoff (continue at v12 ch53 after S1). Two soft spots: eps 15-16 interleave chs 28-30 (both fandom lists carry all three), and fandom's ep 21 list runs through ch 51 while episode content places labyrinth entry (50) and Ramiris (51) in ep 22 — anchored medium there. Ep 24 is a Blu-ray-novel side-story adaptation with no manga counterpart (stays filler, no anchor).
